newsitem.title: USA: Comcast unit to offer $1 bln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Comcast unit to offer $1 bln in notes.

text.p: Comcast Corp said Wednesday its Comcast Cable Communications Inc subsidiary plans to offer about $1.0 billion of notes through a 144A offering with registration rights.
The notes will be obligations of Comcast Cable and will not be obligations of, nor guaranteed by, Comcast Corp.
The interest rate and certain other terms of the notes have not yet been determined and will be based on market conditions at the time of pricing, Comcast said.
Net proceeds will be used to repay existing borrowings by its subsidiaries. The balance, if any, will be used for general corporate purposes.
